verdict.rationale: Mollie documents shareable payment links that can be sent by email or chat, and one summary describes them as 'no-code payment links'. However, every first-party reference describes creating them through the Payment Links API, which requires code. Nothing in the evidence shows a merchant creating a link from the dashboard. Missing for 10: documented dashboard/web-app payment-link creation, evidence of a truly no-code flow from sign-up to first sale, independent or hands-on corroboration.
